purpose: Minimal self-contained repository reproducibility supplement; public-safe content, not a complete archive or a new independent acceptance review.
derivative_changes: Removed archive-oriented output writing and unused imports; emits JSON to standard output.
Added CLI controls, local manifest checking, deterministic expected-result comparison and rejection of optimized Python execution.
Replaced bounded-prime Miller-Rabin helper with deterministic trial-division certification below 2**32.
Added explicit primitive-root, Hamiltonian-cycle and nonunit-holonomy guards.
Implemented the accepted four-table P/U/V/D preparation and instrumented every table multiplication/addition; endpoint functions now use lookups only.
Retained literal weighted-walk reference matrices, defining-inverse checks, paid application schedule and finite-field control cases.
Removed unused endpoint-mutation scratch calculations; retained original control and added executable mutation tests.
Added an explicit preparation_counts field to each applicable result; descriptive provenance strings now point to repository documentation.
Added separately authored regression tests and scope/attribution documentation.
